frozen_commit_note: This file is committed BEFORE evaluation/packet_admission_conformance.py exists in the tree and before any outcome of this benchmark was computed. Nothing below may change after the first execution; a change would invalidate the run.
lane_question_anchored_to: directives/lanes/evaluation.md + state/factory_direction.json lanes.evaluation.question (v50): build the two executable frozen-bar gates that nobody owns, with proven non-vacuity negative controls and a regression comparison against the accepted incumbents, so that a build fails when counter-label support or map semantics regress.
question: Direction v50 makes the two accepted frozen bars a MACHINE-READABLE INPUT OF PACKET ADMISSION 'so no packet, owner card, disclosure or state field can carry ready_for_owner_session=true or human_gate_ready=true while counter-label support is below the frozen bar 4457e971... or geometry below a7452748...'. Is that invariant TRUE, executably, over the ACCEPTED product artifacts? Core Evaluation owns the bars; this benchmark tests whether the bars are actually BINDING where they are declared to bind.

baseline_under_test.claim: state/product.json -> next_recommended (accepted product cycle 39003037673): '(1) the two accepted frozen bars are now a machine-readable gate of packet admission (product/query/packet_admission.py, wired into finalize_summary/recheck_packet and the owner card), so no packet/card/state can carry ready_for_owner_session=true while counter-label support or geometry is below bar'
baseline_under_test.why_this_baseline: It is the product's own accepted statement of the invariant this lane's bars exist to enforce; it is the strongest available baseline and it is falsifiable.

population_P_frozen_enumeration.rule: discovered by glob over the accepted product mount, NOT pre-assumed; the discovered count is recorded in the run record
population_P_frozen_enumeration.traversal: recursive over every dict/list; a hit is any key named 'ready_for_owner_session' or 'human_gate_ready' whose value is exactly true, recorded by its full JSON path

bar_status_source_frozen.primary_is: an ACCEPTED in-lane measurement record; it is READ, never recomputed. No Frontier candidate is re-measured and neither frozen rubric is re-scored by this benchmark.
bar_status_source_frozen.crosscheck_rule: the crosscheck must AGREE with the primary on the served packet (both bars unmet); disagreement is recorded as an environment/evidence error, not silently resolved

metric: violations = |{ a in P : a carries ready_for_owner_session==true or human_gate_ready==true AND the accepted bar status of its packet is LABEL_UNSOUND or GEOMETRY_UNSOUND AND no persisted admission block (packet_admission or packet_admission_blocked key) exists on that same record }|

success_rule_frozen.exit_2: ENVIRONMENT_ERROR, NO record emitted, when the product mount is absent, when no gate_packet directory is discovered, or when the accepted bar record is absent/unreadable. Exit 2 is never a product verdict and never a pass.

hypotheses.H1: At least one accepted artifact record carries ready_for_owner_session==true while its packet's accepted bar status is unsound and no persisted admission block exists on that record. (Fires => exit 1.)
hypotheses.H2: product/query/packet_admission.enforce() provably persists 'packet_admission' and 'ready_for_owner_session_base' on the record it is given; therefore absence of those keys on a shipped packet.json is executable evidence that the admission gate was never applied to that record. (Source-cited inference; recorded, not executed.)
hypotheses.H3: The served packet's disclosure 'd_mega_cluster_share_from_size' fired with share 0.7696 >= threshold_unchanged 0.5 (product direction obligation (2)). Expected HOLDS; a non-hold is reported as a product finding, not suppressed.
hypotheses.H4: No record under results/product/ or state/ carries human_gate_ready==true. Expected HOLDS; a non-hold is reported as a product finding.
hypotheses.H5: Product's own black-box packet_admission.assess(), executed in a child process on its committed snapshots, returns ready_for_owner_session_allowed==false, i.e. THE GATE ITSELF WORKS and the defect class is 'gate never applied to the shipped record', not 'gate broken'. Reported separately; NOT part of the pass rule (it needs the product mount's source tree).

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.rule: every control must hold, otherwise the run exits 2 ENVIRONMENT_OR_UNPROVEN and ALL findings are SUPPRESSED
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.N1_positive_must_fire: synthetic record {ready_for_owner_session: true} evaluated against bars-unmet => must be counted as a violation
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.N2_negative_must_not_fire: synthetic record {ready_for_owner_session: false} against bars-unmet => must NOT be a violation
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.N3_negative_must_not_fire: synthetic record {ready_for_owner_session: true} against LABEL_SOUND + GEOMETRY_SOUND bars => must NOT be a violation (proves the gate is not a tautology)

claim_ceiling: This benchmark can falsify ONE machine-checkable invariant: whether an accepted product artifact record claims owner/human-gate readiness while an accepted frozen bar is unmet and no admission block is persisted on that record. It does NOT measure labels or geometry, does NOT score either frozen rubric, does NOT re-measure any Frontier candidate, does NOT prove map usefulness to a jurist, and does not move or meet either absolute bar. human_gate_ready stays false.
